source_backbone: Royal Botanic Gardens, Kew POWO/WCVP 2026, author-qualified synonym and rank records; primary phylogenetic research 2011, 2014, 2019
accepted_infraspecific_boundary: Eleusine coracana subsp. africana (Kenn.-O'Byrne) Hilu & de Wet
synonym_and_rank_caution: Author-qualified Eleusine indica varieties/subspecies may resolve to three accepted species. Especially distinguish var. oligostachya Honda (E. indica) from var. oligostachya (Link) Fiori (E. tristachya).
native_range_audit: DEFERRED — NOT REVIEWED; no county/native fields changed
photo_and_specimen_identity: HOLD — no voucher/image identity reassignment; existing source identifications not independently verified in taxonomy lane
hybrid_provenance: HOLD — evolutionary A-genome/maternal contribution to E. coracana does not certify a modern E. indica specimen as hybrid
unresolved_evolutionary_parent: UNRESOLVED — second ancestral donor of E. coracana
install_decision: Retain existing Eleusine indica learner; no new card, species/gallery/lesson, county-range, or Pages changes

decisions.subject: Eleusine indica (L.) Gaertn. (1788)
decisions.proposed_decision: Retain existing accepted species in Poaceae, genus Eleusine, species rank
decisions.detail: POWO/WCVP accepts Eleusine indica; canonical binomial correct, author should be retained in evidence.

decisions.subject: Cynosurus indicus L. (1753)
decisions.proposed_decision: Preserve as homotypic basionym/alias of E. indica, not a separate learner species
decisions.detail: Listed by POWO under E. indica homotypic synonyms.

decisions.subject: Cynodon indicus (L.) Raspail
decisions.proposed_decision: Preserve as homotypic alias of E. indica, not accepted Cynodon species
decisions.detail: Genus-transfer combination maps to accepted E. indica.

decisions.subject: Eleusine distans Moench (1794)
decisions.proposed_decision: Preserve as illegitimate superfluous homotypic synonym of E. indica
decisions.detail: Do not confuse with later E. distans Link, also illegitimate but a later homonym.

decisions.subject: Eleusine indica var. major E.Fourn.
decisions.proposed_decision: Map historical variety to E. indica at species rank; no independently accepted variety
decisions.detail: Listed among POWO heterotypic synonyms.

decisions.subject: Eleusine indica var. oligostachya Honda (1927)
decisions.proposed_decision: Map to E. indica; require author Honda in search alias
decisions.detail: POWO places Honda's 1927 variety under E. indica, unlike Fiori's differently authored homonymous-looking combination.

decisions.subject: Eleusine coracana (L.) Gaertn.
decisions.proposed_decision: Preserve separately accepted finger millet species; do not merge with E. indica
decisions.detail: POWO accepts E. coracana as a distinct species.

decisions.subject: Eleusine coracana subsp. africana (Kenn.-O'Byrne) Hilu & de Wet
decisions.proposed_decision: Preserve as accepted subspecies of E. coracana
decisions.detail: POWO recognizes two accepted E. coracana subspecies; this is one.

decisions.subject: Eleusine indica var. coracana (L.) Fiori
decisions.proposed_decision: Map historical E. indica variety to accepted E. coracana
decisions.detail: POWO lists this as homotypic synonym of E. coracana, not E. indica.

decisions.subject: Eleusine indica subsp. coracana (L.) Lye
decisions.proposed_decision: Map historical E. indica subspecies to accepted E. coracana
decisions.detail: POWO lists this under E. coracana homotypic synonyms.

decisions.subject: Eleusine indica subsp. africana (Kenn.-O'Byrne) S.M.Phillips
decisions.proposed_decision: Map to E. coracana subsp. africana
decisions.detail: Current POWO infraspecific destination differs from historic E. indica parent binomial.

decisions.subject: Eleusine africana Kenn.-O'Byrne
decisions.proposed_decision: Preserve as synonym of E. coracana subsp. africana under current POWO backbone
decisions.detail: Some historical sources accept E. africana as species; record alternative treatments without silently creating duplicate.

decisions.subject: Eleusine tristachya (Lam.) Lam.
decisions.proposed_decision: Preserve as a separately accepted Eleusine species
decisions.detail: POWO does not synonymize E. tristachya into E. indica.

decisions.subject: Eleusine indica var. tristachya (Lam.) Fiori
decisions.proposed_decision: Map to E. tristachya
decisions.detail: Homotypic synonym of E. tristachya, not E. indica.

decisions.subject: Eleusine indica var. oligostachya (Link) Fiori (1896)
decisions.proposed_decision: Map to E. tristachya, distinguishing from E. indica var. oligostachya Honda
decisions.detail: Same abbreviated genus/species/rank/epithet hides two different author-qualified names with different POWO destinations.

decisions.subject: Eleusine indica var. condensata Döll
decisions.proposed_decision: Map to E. tristachya
decisions.detail: Heterotypic synonym of E. tristachya.

decisions.subject: Eleusine indica subsp. barcinonensis (Costa) K.Richt.
decisions.proposed_decision: Map to E. tristachya
decisions.detail: Heterotypic synonym of E. tristachya.

decisions.subject: Evolutionary maternal relationship of E. indica and E. coracana
decisions.proposed_decision: Record qualified evidence for E. indica as maternal genome contributor, not taxonomic synonymy or an individual hybrid determination
decisions.detail: Molecular/cytogenetic literature supports E. indica A-genome/maternal ancestry; competing models and unsampled/extinct ancestral lineages remain possible.

decisions.subject: Bulk assignment of all historical E. indica infraspecific names to goosegrass
decisions.proposed_decision: Reject automatic synonym mapping based on first two binomial words
decisions.detail: Some historical names map to E. coracana or E. tristachya, while author-qualified Honda oligostachya maps to E. indica.

decisions.subject: Treat E. coracana or E. tristachya as E. indica solely because of evolutionary relatedness
decisions.proposed_decision: Reject species collapse or unapproved duplicate-card mapping
decisions.detail: Distinct accepted species under POWO/WCVP; hybrid ancestry and common genome components do not establish synonymy.

decisions.subject: Identification of individual Eleusine indica learner photographs/specimens
decisions.proposed_decision: Keep identity provenance hold separate from accepted-name PASS
decisions.detail: This name audit did not inspect specimen vouchers or image pixels; no photo reassignment or confirmation.

decisions.subject: Contemporary hybrid identity or cultivar ancestry of any goosegrass observation
decisions.proposed_decision: Do not infer a named hybrid or recent introgression for any gallery plant
decisions.detail: Evolutionary maternal ancestry is not proof of recent hybrid origin for an individual plant.

decisions.subject: Identity of the second ancestral genome contributor to E. coracana
decisions.proposed_decision: Preserve unresolved paternal/B-genome ancestor rather than invent an exact accepted donor species
decisions.detail: Published molecular models support maternal contributions but differ on or cannot resolve the paternal lineage.
